source_of_truth: Parent roadmap 2026-05-22-001 defines V2 as guided setup: use setup_steps[] to execute safe automatable work, display human-required work, and verify capability readiness without storing secrets.

user_journeys.name: operator-prints-guided-setup
user_journeys.description: An operator runs a print-only setup command and receives an ordered checklist for one capability without executing anything.
acceptance_signals: Print-only setup renders all setup_steps[] in order

user_journeys.name: agent-runs-safe-automatable-steps
user_journeys.description: An agent or operator runs the guarded setup runner with confirm; only allowlisted automatable steps execute, human-required steps are skipped, and verification runs after attempts.

completion_test: The setup runner can print Firebase setup steps without execution, safely execute a fixture automatable step only with confirm, skip human-required work, write no-secret evidence, and pass relevant tests.
